name: Protected by the Stars adds armor from Intellect and shortens stuns and disarms (#1531)
contract: Protected by the Stars 300258 (Spell.dbc, passive) has three effects. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_OF_STAT_PERCENT (182, the issue's 'Aura_182'), EffectMiscValue 1 (physical school mask), EffectMiscValueB 3 (Intellect), EffectBasePoints 299 with DieSides 1 -> 300%. Effects 1 and 2 are SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD (232) for mechanic 3 (MECHANIC_DISARM) and 12 (MECHANIC_STUN), EffectBasePoints -26 -> -25%. The tooltip is 'Increases your Armor by 300% of your Intellect and reduces the duration of stuns and disarms against you by 25%.'. Nothing in the module or SQL touches 300258. ARMOR: Player::UpdateArmor (StatSystem.cpp:371) adds CalculatePct(GetStat(Intellect), amount) for each 182 effect whose misc value intersects SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL, and STAT_INTELLECT updates call UpdateArmor. The absolute Intellect of a Starcaller is not in any file this task may read, so the scenario adds a known +100 Intellect with Arcane Intellect 36880 (aura 29 Intellect, EffectBasePoints 99 -> +100, self-target, 30 minutes) and asserts the armor delta: 300% of +100 is +300 on the talented fixture and 0 on the control (its armor has no Intellect term); the band 295-305 allows integer truncation. DURATIONS: Unit::ModSpellDuration applies GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, mechanic) to negative auras for every mechanic in the spell's effect mask, and self casts are included (the comment 'also calculate self casts'), with no diminishing return on a self cast (Spell.cpp: unit != m_caster is required). The fixtures are two real self casts, never set_aura, because Unit::AddAura never calls ModSpellDuration: Dropped Weapon 25057 (SpellFamilyName 0, SPELL_ATTR0_AURA_IS_DEBUFF 0x4000000, effect 0 self-target aura 67 disarm, Mechanic 3, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms) and Exhaustion 35492 (SpellFamilyName 0, 0x4000000, aura 12 stun, Mechanic 12, DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms). Expected on the talented fixture: 7500 ms and 2250 ms; the control keeps 10000 and 3000. Bands allow scheduling delay between cast and read: disarm 6500-7600 vs control >= 9000, stun 1500-2300 vs control >= 2400. The stun is cast last because a stunned fixture can cast nothing more.
